expr: (() => { const s=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root label')].find(l=>/^\s*Nopeus/.test(l.textContent)).querySelector('select'), ks=["dL", "L", "rel", "spacing", "amp"], a=ks.map(k=>window.simState[k]); s.value='0.5'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return new Promise(f => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { const b=ks.map(k=>window.simState[k]); s.value='1'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); f(a.every((x,i)=>x===b[i]) ? 1 : 0); }))); })()
